description: Concentration in each tube of a serial dilution, plus the transfer and diluent volume per tube. Output concentrations use the same unit as start_conc. For laboratory calculations only.

factor.description: Dilution factor per step. Must be greater than 1.

start_conc.description: Starting concentration. Must be greater than 0.

steps.description: Number of tubes, a whole number from 1 to 20.

volume_per_tube_ml.description: Final volume in each tube, in mL. Must be greater than 0.

name: serial_dilution
title: Serial dilution
